discharge_profile.primary_diagnosis: Severe Right Knee Osteoarthritis, post-operative arthroplasty
discharge_profile.dietary_instructions: Regular balanced diet, high protein for tissue healing, adequate fiber and hydration to prevent opioid constipation.
discharge_profile.activity_restrictions: Weight bearing as tolerated with rolling walker. Do not pivot or twist on operative knee. Avoid pillows directly under knee (keep leg straight to prevent flexion contracture).
discharge_profile.wound_care_instructions: Keep waterproof dressing intact until clinic visit. Ice operative knee 20 minutes every 2 hours as needed for swelling.

medications.indication: DVT / PE prophylaxis post joint arthroplasty
medications.warning: Critical blood thinner. Do not miss doses. Rotate abdomen injection sites.

medications.frequency: Once daily in the morning with food
Every 4-6 hours PRN severe breakthrough pain only
medications.warning: May cause drowsiness and constipation. Taper as pain improves.

red_flag_warnings: Calf pain, cramping, localized swelling, redness, or heat in either calf (warning sign of Deep Vein Thrombosis)
Sudden shortness of breath, rapid breathing, or sharp chest pain on inhalation (Pulmonary Embolism)
Fever over 101.5°F, shaking chills, or foul-smelling drainage from knee dressing
Sudden inability to bear weight or severe uncontrolled pain not responding to prescribed medication

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Daily DVT Anticoagulant Injection (Lovenox)
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Inject 40mg Lovenox subcutaneously into abdomen skin fold. Alternate sides.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Home PT: Ankle Pumps & Quad Sets
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Perform 20 ankle pumps and 10 quad heel slides to maintain circulation.

initial_care_tasks_day_2.title: Knee Dressing Check & Cryotherapy (Ice)
initial_care_tasks_day_2.description: Apply cold pack over knee dressing for 20 mins. Confirm dressing is dry.
